firmwares.description:
This update contains various improvements and tweaks.

      We highly recommend updating to ensure stability and performance.

Adds MP-76 support.

      Advanced BodyRez settings are now correctly stored over power cycles.

A Guitar Delay effect was added as well as the ability to store

      unique guitar effects with each preset (turn Global Guitar FX OFF in Setup).

      

      The Guitar Anti-Feedback menu now moves to Setup and remains global.

      

      A Looper click bug was resolved.

      

      Your edited Guitar effects, Vocal effects and Setup will not be lost

      with this update but we recommend that you use the 'Backup All' feature

      in the Preset tab as a precaution.

This update doubles the amount of loop recording time in all output modes:

      Stereo and Dual Mono are now 30 seconds, Mono is 1 minute.

      Turning Loop Undo off in Setup doubles these times again.
In the setup for Switch-3/6, MIDI commands (CC102 to CC107) appear.
